name: Human respondent to a court arbitration: real accept/refuse controls, EXECUTE_SCRIPT acknowledgement, next-turn legitimacy and peace/order consequences, and six save/load round trips. AI incoming petitions are seeded test fixtures because AI petitioning is not implemented. Two distinct wars avoid redeclaring on the turn of forced peace. Only two real turns.

if ContextPtr:IsHidden() or Controls.PactToggle:IsHidden() then error('pact UI entry hidden') end
if not Controls.PactPanel:IsHidden() then error('pact panel unexpectedly open') end
Controls.PactToggle:DoLeftClick()
if Controls.PactPanel:IsHidden() then error('pact panel did not open') end
Controls.PactToggle:DoLeftClick()
if not Controls.PactPanel:IsHidden() then error('pact panel did not close') end
return 'visible pact entry opens and closes its panel'

local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_CourtArbitration
if not R then error('arbitration gameplay not loaded') end
local human
local ids={}
for _,p in ipairs(PlayerManager.GetAliveMajors()) do
  if p:IsHuman() then
    if human then error('more than one human') end
    human=p:GetID()
  else ids[#ids+1]=p:GetID() end
end
if human==nil or PlayerConfigurations[human]:GetCivilizationTypeName()~=R.ASHIKAGA then
  error('expected Ashikaga human')
end
if R.GameTurn()~=1 or Game:GetProperty(R.PENDING_KEY)~=nil then
  error('unexpected turn or pending request before accept')
end
table.sort(ids)
local previous=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_HUMAN_TEST')
local other
for _,id in ipairs(ids) do
  local d=Players[human]:GetDiplomacy()
  if other==nil and (not previous or id~=previous.other) and not d:IsAtWarWith(id)
    and not d:HasAllied(id) and Players[id]:GetCities():GetCount()>0 then other=id end
end
if other==nil then error('no independent AI opponent for accept') end
if Game:GetProperty(R.TruceKey(human,other))~=nil then error('fixture opponent already under a truce') end
Players[other]:GetDiplomacy():DeclareWarOn(human,WarTypes.FORMAL_WAR,true)
if not Players[human]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(other) then error('fixture war not started') end
Players[human]:SetProperty(R.LEGITIMACY_KEY,65)
Players[other]:SetProperty(R.LEGITIMACY_KEY,50)
Players[other]:GetTreasury():ChangeGoldBalance(200)
local ok,reason=R.CheckRequest(other,other,human)
if not ok then error('fixture request invalid: '..tostring(reason)) end
local turn=R.GameTurn()
-- AI petitions are not implemented yet. Seed the same paid, incoming state as OnRequest;
-- only the human answer below must travel through the actual screen and EXECUTE_SCRIPT.
Players[other]:GetTreasury():ChangeGoldBalance(-100)
Players[other]:SetProperty(R.LEGITIMACY_KEY,45)
Game:SetProperty(R.PENDING_KEY,{Requester=other,A=other,B=human,Turn=turn,Power=1})
Game:SetProperty(R.LAST_REQUEST_KEY,turn)
Game:SetProperty('JAC_ARB_HUMAN_TEST',{case='accept',human=human,other=other,turn=turn,initial=65})
NotificationManager.SendNotification(human,NotificationTypes.USER_DEFINED_1,{
  [ParameterTypes.MESSAGE]=Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_ARB_NOTIFY_REQUEST_NAME'),
  [ParameterTypes.SUMMARY]=Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_ARB_NOTIFY_REQUEST_SUMMARY',
    Locale.Lookup(R.NameKey(other)),Locale.Lookup(R.NameKey(other)),Locale.Lookup(R.NameKey(human)))})
return 'accept: incoming arbitration seeded for human '..human..' from AI '..other

  propertyText(Game:GetProperty(R.TruceKey(t.human,t.other))),
  propertyText(Game:GetProperty(R.PeaceTurnKey(t.human,t.other))),
  propertyText(Game:GetProperty(R.AwaitKey(t.human,t.other))),
  propertyText(Players[t.human]:GetProperty(R.OUTLAW_KEY)),

  propertyText(Players[t.human]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(t.other)),

  end
else out[#out+1]='no pending' end
local cities={}

local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_CourtArbitration
if not R then error('arbitration gameplay not loaded') end
local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_HUMAN_TEST')
if not t or not Players[t.human]:IsHuman() then error('human fixture missing or no longer human') end

    if R.GameTurn()~=t.turn+1 then error('ruling advanced more than one turn') end
    if Game:GetProperty(R.PENDING_KEY)~=nil then error('arbitration not resolved') end
    local expected=t.initial+t.income+5
    if R.Legitimacy(t.human)~=expected then
      error('human legitimacy '..R.Legitimacy(t.human)..' expected '..expected)
    end
    if Game:GetProperty(R.AwaitKey(t.human,t.other))~=nil then error('unexpected deferred peace') end

        if Players[t.human]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(t.other) or Players[t.other]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(t.human) then
          error('accepted arbitration did not make peace')
        end
        if Game:GetProperty(R.TruceKey(t.human,t.other))~=t.turn+1+10
          or Game:GetProperty(R.PeaceTurnKey(t.human,t.other))~=t.turn+1 then error('wrong truce or peace turn') end
        if Players[t.human]:GetProperty(R.OUTLAW_KEY)~=nil or Players[t.other]:GetProperty(R.OUTLAW_KEY)~=nil then
          error('acceptance unexpectedly caused an outlaw order')
        end
        local count=0
        for _,c in Players[t.human]:GetCities():Members() do
          local pl=Map.GetPlot(c:GetX(),c:GetY())
          if pl:GetProperty(R.FLAG_HIGH)~=1 or pl:GetProperty(R.FLAG_LOW)~=0 then error('high legitimacy flags missing') end
          count=count+1
        end
        if count==0 then error('no human cities checked') end
        return 'human acceptance: +5 plus income, immediate peace, 10-turn truce, high flags in '..count..' cities'

-- An unset Civ6 property returns no values. Bind it to one argument before tostring.
local function propertyText(value) return tostring(value) end
local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_CourtArbitration

local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_HUMAN_TEST')
if not t or not Players[t.human]:IsHuman() then error('human fixture missing or no longer human') end

local p=Game:GetProperty(R.PENDING_KEY)
local out={t.case, propertyText(R.GameTurn()), propertyText(R.Legitimacy(t.human)),
  propertyText(R.Legitimacy(t.other)), propertyText(Players[t.human]:GetTreasury():GetGoldBalance()),
  propertyText(Players[t.other]:GetTreasury():GetGoldBalance()),
  propertyText(Game:GetProperty(R.LAST_REQUEST_KEY)), propertyText(Game:GetProperty(R.LAST_EVENT_KEY)),

  propertyText(Game:GetProperty(R.AwaitKey(t.human,t.other))),

  propertyText(Players[t.other]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(t.human))}
if p then
  for _,k in ipairs({'Requester','A','B','Turn','Power','AnswerA','AnswerB'}) do

  end
else out[#out+1]='no pending' end
local cities={}

local R=ExposedMembers.JAC_CourtArbitration
if not R then error('arbitration gameplay not loaded') end
local t=Game:GetProperty('JAC_ARB_HUMAN_TEST')
if not t or not Players[t.human]:IsHuman() then error('human fixture missing or no longer human') end

    if R.GameTurn()~=t.turn+1 then error('ruling advanced more than one turn') end
    if Game:GetProperty(R.PENDING_KEY)~=nil then error('arbitration not resolved') end
    local expected=t.initial+t.income+-15
    if R.Legitimacy(t.human)~=expected then
      error('human legitimacy '..R.Legitimacy(t.human)..' expected '..expected)
    end
    if Game:GetProperty(R.AwaitKey(t.human,t.other))~=nil then error('unexpected deferred peace') end

        if not Players[t.human]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(t.other) or not Players[t.other]:GetDiplomacy():IsAtWarWith(t.human) then
          error('refused arbitration unexpectedly made peace')
        end
        if Game:GetProperty(R.TruceKey(t.human,t.other))~=nil or Game:GetProperty(R.PeaceTurnKey(t.human,t.other))~=nil then
          error('refused arbitration unexpectedly created a truce')
        end
        if Players[t.human]:GetProperty(R.OUTLAW_KEY)~=t.turn+1+10 then error('wrong human outlaw expiry') end
        if not R.HasJoined(t.other,t.human,R.GameTurn()) then error('AI opponent did not join the order against the human') end
        local ok,reason=R.CheckRequest(t.human,t.human,t.other)
        if ok or reason~='LEGITIMACY' then error('human below 30 still allowed to petition: '..tostring(reason)) end
        local count=0
        for _,c in Players[t.human]:GetCities():Members() do
          local pl=Map.GetPlot(c:GetX(),c:GetY())
          if pl:GetProperty(R.FLAG_LOW)~=1 or pl:GetProperty(R.FLAG_HIGH)~=0 then error('low legitimacy flags missing') end
          count=count+1
        end
        if count==0 then error('no human cities checked') end
        return 'human refusal: -15 plus income, war continues, 10-turn order, low flags in '..count..' cities'
